verdict.rationale: Phaser's pricing page says games you create are not tied to the licence and that project files can be moved to VS Code, so you can leave the Editor. The engine itself is MIT-licensed, which limits lock-in. However, nothing documents a full export of all account or hosted data (Game Agent projects, account data) or names the open formats project files use. Missing for 10: a documented full data-export capability, an explicit open-format specification for exported projects, coverage of hosted Game Agent or account data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful migration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: any games you created will still work — they are not linked to the licence. You can also transfer your project files to VS Code.
